description: This is a Python source file implementing authentication routes for a web service using FastAPI. It defines endpoints for user signup, login, token refresh, and retrieving current user info, utilizing SQLAlchemy for database interactions and custom security modules for token handling.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing users in the database with properties like email, password, role, and status.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enumeration or class defining user roles such as 'USER'.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response containing access token, refresh token, and token type.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for user registration input data.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Schema for user login input data.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for output representation of user data.

classes.name: TokenRefreshRequest
classes.description: Schema for refresh token request payload.

methods.name: UserOut signup(payload: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, checks for existing email, hashes password, creates user, and returns user info.

methods.name: Token login(payload: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT tokens if valid.

methods.name: Token refresh_token(data: TokenRefreshRequest)
methods.description: Validates refresh token and issues a new access token, optionally rotating the refresh token.

methods.name: UserOut read_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^async def login(payload: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)) -> Token:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^async def signup(payload: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
